**Big but shallow: 1082 hits across 94 files.**

| Zone | Hits | Rename? |
|---|---|---|
| Service JS names in `services/` | 900 | Yes |
| SQL column refs in `*/repo/*.js` | 125 | No. Needs an `ALTER TABLE` first |
| Applied migrations in `migrations/` | 37 | No. Editing history breaks the down step |
| `vendor/reporting-sdk/` | 12 | No. `npm run vendor:refresh` overwrites it |
| [docs/openapi.yaml](docs/openapi.yaml:16) | 5 | No. Frozen public field |
| [lib/serialize.js:8](lib/serialize.js:8) WIRE value | 1 | No. That key is the wire name |

So 900 of 1082 are truly free. The other 182 are contract or history.

Ask for a column-rename migration before you sign.
